title: Fuse canonical CSR validation scans without weakening fail-closed semantics

diff.note: Most additions are focused fail-closed/error-precedence tests; the production file changes by +35/-10.

question: Can the repeated generic whole-array and per-row validation scans identified by GPU-11 be fused inside the one canonical TypedRelationBlock constructor without adding a trusted constructor or changing persisted semantics?

change.offset_validation: Replace separate generic integer and monotonicity generator scans with one explicit offsets pass while preserving boundary/start and error precedence.
change.column_validation: Replace separate integer, range, and per-row strict-order scans/slices with one bounded explicit column pass that tracks row boundaries and defers errors in the same semantic precedence.
change.scalar_validation: Keep existing _stored scalar admission before structural CSR validation, including zero rejection and semiring-specific scalar contracts.
change.canonicalization: Keep tuple normalization, public constructors, wire format, digest computation, semiring oracle, axes, and Fourfold subject unchanged.
change.test_contract: Add focused digest/JSON parity, seven structural error-precedence cases, scalar-before-structure precedence, and a source guard against reintroducing generic any/per-row slices in TypedRelationBlock.__post_init__.

preserved_error_precedence: column range before common CSR entry count
common CSR entry count before strict per-row column ordering
semiring scalar admission before structural CSR validation
